abstract: OBJECTIVE: The purpose of this study was to assess the a priori chance that primary cystic lesions of the retrorectal space are malignant and to investigate MRI characteristics that indicate malignancy. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Patients referred to a center for colorectal surgery were recruited from 2000 to 2014. Lesions were proven by clinical assessment and histopathology. MRI was performed at 1.5 T with examinations evaluated by two radiologists. Interobserver agreement was assessed (Cohen kappa) and differences between malignant and benign lesions calculated (Fisher exact test). RESULTS: Twenty-eight patients (22 women, six men; age range, 18-70 years) with 31 lesions were included. Lesions were categorized as tailgut cysts (n = 16, 52%), teratomas (n = 9, 29%), lesions of colorectal origin (n = 4, 13%), or neurogenic lesions (n = 2, 6%). Five patients (18%) had malignant lesions. Colorectal lesions had the highest percentage of malignancy (3/4, 75%). A solid tissue component was found in all five (100%) malignant lesions and two (8%) of the benign lesions, which were both teratomas (p < 0.05). Sensitivity and specificity for malignancy according to the presence of a solid tissue component was 100% (5/5) and 92% (24/26). For unilocularity, multilocularity, debris, septa, and wall thickening, differences were not significant. Interobserver agreement was excellent (κ = 1) for all characteristics except debris (κ = 0.795). CONCLUSION: The majority of retrorectal cystic lesions are benign. The presence of a solid tissue component should raise suspicion for malignancy.
abstract_ja: 目的：直腸後腔の原発性嚢胞性病変が悪性である事前確率を評価し、悪性を示すMRI所見を調べることを目的としました。材料と方法：2000年から2014年に大腸外科の専門施設に紹介された患者を対象としました。病変は臨床評価と病理組織学的検査により確定されました。MRIは1.5Tで撮像され、2名の放射線科医が読影しました。観察者間一致度（Cohenのκ）を評価し、悪性病変と良性病変の差をFisherの正確確率検定で算出しました。結果：31病変を有する28例（女性22例、男性6例、年齢18〜70歳）を対象としました。病変の内訳は、尾腸嚢胞16例（52%）、奇形腫9例（29%）、大腸由来の病変4例（13%）、神経原性病変2例（6%）でした。5例（18%）が悪性病変でした。大腸由来の病変で悪性率が最も高くなりました（3/4、75%）。悪性病変5例すべて（100%）と、良性病変2例（8%）に充実性成分が認められ、これら2例はいずれも奇形腫でした（p<0.05）。充実性成分の有無による悪性の感度と特異度は、100%（5/5）と92%（24/26）でした。単房性、多房性、デブリス、隔壁、壁肥厚については有意差はありませんでした。観察者間一致度は、デブリス（κ=0.795）を除くすべての所見で優秀（κ=1）でした。結論：直腸後腔の嚢胞性病変の大部分は良性です。充実性成分の存在は悪性を疑うべき所見です。
